allowUnreviewed.title: Allow plugins AutoScene has not reviewed?
allowUnreviewed.text:
They run with your user rights: they can read, change and send anything you can. Install only plugins from people you trust.

Turning this off again stops their runs. It doesn't undo what a plugin set up outside AutoScene.

hung.title: Plugin “{{name}}”'s page stopped responding.
hung.text: Close it to use AutoScene again, or wait for it.

runs.program: It runs with your user rights: it can read, change and send anything you can.

runs.pagesOnly: It runs no program: its pages run in a sandbox.
runs.leftSandbox: The installed version ran in a sandbox. This version runs with your user rights: it can read, change and send anything you can.
runs.startsProgram: The installed version runs no program. This version runs one with your user rights: it can read, change and send anything you can.
runs.startsSandboxed: The installed version runs no program. This version runs one in a sandbox: it sees only its own folder and what it asks for.
runs.becomesService: It now keeps its program running while its page is open.
